blocks.text: DX Manager uses Android Developer options and ADB to run DeX and single windows for the connected phone. Enable Developer options and USB debugging on the phone first.

blocks.heading: First connection
items: Connect the phone with USB and enable USB debugging.
Allow USB debugging in the approval prompt shown on the phone.
Choose the connected phone in the DX Manager device list.

blocks.heading: If the phone has not been authorized
blocks.text: Unlock the phone and check for the USB debugging approval prompt. DeX and file transfer cannot start until the approval is granted.
DeX opens the phone's Samsung DeX virtual display in a Windows window. A single window runs one selected app on its own virtual display.

blocks.heading: How to start
items: Choose the connected phone at the top of the main page.
Review the resolution, DPI, and run options.
DeX can start without a start app. A single window requires one selected start app.

blocks.text: The last DeX and single-window 1–3 options and selected apps are saved separately for each phone.

blocks.heading: When the phone is not listed
items: Check the USB cable and the phone's USB connection mode.
Unlock the phone and check for the USB debugging approval prompt.
Use Refresh on the main page, then choose the phone again.

blocks.text: For Wi-Fi ADB, the phone and PC must be on the same network. The saved connection policy and the live connection can differ, so check status on the Connection page in Settings.

blocks.heading: When a session fails to launch
blocks.text: Some apps restrict launching or mirroring while USB debugging is enabled, or because of DRM or security policies. Check the phone approval prompt and the session log first.
To send from the PC to the phone, drag files or folders onto a Scrcpy window. Set the destination folder on the Paths page in Settings.

The optional DX Companion supports phone-to-PC transfer and phone-side display cleanup. It is installed only when you explicitly request installation and permission from the Companion page in Settings.

blocks.heading: When a transfer does not start
blocks.text: Check that the phone is authorized for ADB and is currently connected. Do not disconnect that phone while a transfer is active.
Keep the phone connected, right-click the DX Manager icon in the system tray, and choose Exit. The main window's close button hides DX Manager in the tray; it does not exit the program.

blocks.heading: If a small virtual display remains on the phone
items: Open Simulate secondary displays in Developer options on the phone.
Even if None is already selected, select any resolution once.
Open the menu again and select None.
If DX Companion is installed, you can also use Clean all on its Phone cleanup screen.

blocks.heading: Important
blocks.text: A virtual display or a stay-awake setting can remain after disconnection, a forced exit, or Windows shutdown. Use the steps above to clean up the phone.
